description: This Java class 'SlidingWindowCounter' implements a sliding window mechanism for counting success and failure measurements over specified time windows using concurrent data structures. It provides methods for incrementing counters, retrieving counts, and cleaning up old measurements, primarily used for monitoring or metrics in a messaging service context.

classes.name: SlidingWindowCounter
classes.description: A final class implementing a sliding window counter for measuring success and failure events over configurable time windows.
